data.content_ref: inline:The reliability of the system integrates the 'Checklist-Task Fit' (SRC_005) with the 'Resolution Dependency' (SRC_002), proposing that 'genuine reliability' is an emergent property of the alignment between checklist granularity and the task's world-type (closed vs open). This relation is refuted if the outcome's reliability remains constant regardless of whether the task is closed-world or open-world, provided the checklist resolution is high.
